articles.title: White hats rescue $500K in NFTs after Flooring exploit
articles.snippet: CoinGecko and NFT Price Floor data show NFT market cap has cooled since April, while CryptoPunks and BAYC remain top collections by value.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Massive ZCash Exploit Found by Claude, Extent Unknown
articles.snippet: The ZCash team hired a hacker to find an exploit in the ZCash protocol, and he exposed a glitch that has been out there for four years.
